verdict.rationale: Jan runs model inference and exposes a local OpenAI-compatible API server powered by llama.cpp, so inference-serving optimizations are a fair question for it. However, the evidence never mentions splitting prefill and decode phases or any large-scale disaggregated serving architecture. The documented server is a single local endpoint, so there is no product-level support for this story.

support.subject: As a developer, I can disaggregate prefill and decode phases for optimized large-scale serving
